title: fix(app-shell): Studio draws labels, not names, on the explain access chips and banner and the list-view Columns rows (objectui#12693)
body:
Fixes #12693
Clause-②: no

Studio drew machine names where labels exist on two surfaces. It now draws each item's metadata label and falls back to the name only when no label exists.

## What changed

**Explain access** (`AccessExplainPanel.tsx`)
- `POST /api/v1/security/explain` names the principal's positions and permission sets, and the object, by name only. The panel now labels them itself.
- Once per run, it lists `position` and `permission` from the metadata API, but only for a type the decision cites an unlabelled name of. This is the same `client.list` read the Access pillar's rail makes, so there is no new request per chip and no second label resolver.
- Each Principal chip shows the label, with the name on its `title`.
- The verdict banner names the object by the label the panel's own object picker already holds.
- A name with no label, a name the list does not carry, or a failed list read leaves the name, which is what the chip read before. The explain request is unchanged.

**List-view Columns** (`FieldsListEditor.tsx`, `ViewColumnPanes.tsx`)
- A list view stores bare field names. Each Columns row now shows the field's label from the catalog the inspector already passes in, when the column has no label of its own. The field name stays on the row's `title` and in its secondary text.
- The stored `columns` are unchanged.
- An object column's own `label` still wins, and a name the catalog does not know still reads as the name.
- The metadata-admin view and column inspectors share this editor, so their rows read the same way.

Clause-② is no: no export, exported prop or i18n key moves. These components are not on the package entry.

## Evidence

Measured on the published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2` showcase, booted with `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, admin principal. Screenshots are on branch `claude/issue-12693-evidence` under `evidence/12693/`.

| | before (main 3288c12) | after |
|---|---|---|
| banner | Read on “showcase_task” | Read on “Task” |
| position chips | platform_admin, org_owner, exec … | Platform Admin, Organization Owner, Executive … (name on title) |
| permission-set chips | showcase_member_default, member_default … | Showcase Member (Default), Member — Standard Access … |
| Projects LIST VIEW columns | name, account, status … | Project Name, Account, Status … (name on title) |

## Tests

- `AccessExplainPanel.citedLabels-12693.test.tsx` (7 tests):
  - chips draw labels with the name on `title`;
  - each type is read once per run;
  - the banner shows the object label;
  - controls: a label-less or unknown name, an object with no label and a failed list all leave the name, and the request body is unchanged.
- `FieldsListEditor.fieldLabels-12693.test.tsx` (4 tests):
  - string columns draw the catalog label with the name on `title`;
  - a remove keeps `columns` as names;
  - controls: an unknown name stays the name, and an object column's own label wins.
- Ablation, with the fix committed: each mutation turned its tests red (4/7, 4/4 and 2/4). The restored blobs equal HEAD.
- At head 2808bc0, the full `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` (207 files, 1474 tests) and `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` (538 files, 6030 passed, 1 skipped) suites pass. The #11823 list-view inspector pin now names a column's remove control by the field label ("Remove Status").

## Acceptance notes

- The pipeline layers' "Contributed by" chips in the same dialog still print machine names. They are outside this card's claim; noted, not filed.
